mechanism: Spironolactone increases renal potassium retention and reduces magnesium excretion, while magnesium supplementation can further elevate serum potassium and magnesium levels, increasing risk of hyperkalemia and hypermagnesemia.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; use magnesium supplementation cautiously and only when clinically indicated with dose adjustment; educate patient on dietary magnesium sources.
